text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 2–2.5% over the past day, signaling modest profit-taking after a sustained rally that has pushed the Fear & Greed Index into Greed territory. Bitcoin dominance at 58.9% suggests strength in the major pair relative to alts, though the 20-point rise in sentiment over a week indicates conviction remains intact despite the pullback. Volume at $248B is solid, pointing to real liquidty behind the move rather than thin-market noise.
